failure_summary.description: The agent selected a related clue detail instead of identifying the requested answer from the full clue and its corroborating context.
The core answer was identified, but the response added an unnecessary title, used the wrong grammatical number, or omitted a conventional initial.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers implicit clue targets, reliance on the full clue rather than keyword matches, returning modern headwords instead of etymons, avoiding unrequested truth judgments, and preserving concise canonical answer forms. These failures primarily reflect not applying those existing rules, so adding more guidance would duplicate the skill.
